about: Worked cases for the Draft and Returned rule (docs/plans/student-page-build-plan.md 1.2). One file, run through the SQL triggers (migrations/local-test/grade_return.py) and through shared/grade-state.js, so the two cannot drift.

how_to_read.class: The class settings the case starts with: student_page (course.student_page_enabled) and return_grades (on_return, on_save or null for no choice made).
how_to_read.work: What kind of assessment one student is graded on: competencies (levels on t1 and t2), rubric (criteria c1 and c2, with checkbox k1 on c1 and k2 on c2), points (one score), or dibels (a DIBELS benchmark: a reading record, not a grade that is returned, so whatever is saved on it the piece is never Draft or Returned and the student is given nothing for it).
how_to_read.steps: In order. A step with "do" is something that happens; a step with "expect" is what must be true at that point.

do.level: A competency level: tag, value (0 clears it), and optionally modifier and comment.
do.criterion: A criterion level: criterion, value (0 clears it), and optionally modifier, comment and beyond. A comment or beyond left out keeps the saved one.
do.score: Points, a mark or an Overall level: value, and optionally modifier.
do.tick: An Advanced Rubric checkbox: check, on.
do.note: The Note for the Report: text.
do.status: Missing (NS), Excused (EXC), Late (LATE) or null to take it off.
do.class: The class settings change: student_page, return_grades.
do.move_rubric: Edit a Copy on rubric work: it moves to a copy of its rubric. c1 becomes c3, c2 becomes c4, k1 becomes k3, k2 becomes k4.
do.delete: The teacher deletes a criterion, a competency or a checkbox from the class: what (criterion, tag or check) and id.
do.student (on any step): Which student the step is about: s1 (the default) or s2. A return step may list students instead.

expect.state: draft: the working copy holds something the student has not been given. returned: nothing is waiting and the student has a grade. none: no grade is returned and none is waiting.
expect.student: The grade the student is given, as a copy, or null for nothing. A draft is never in it; nothing is given while the piece is Missing or Excused; and only what the work is scored by now is in it (a deleted criterion, competency or checkbox is gone at once; on competency work the score value is given only when the grade holds no competency level at all).
expect.status: The status the student sees. It is never a draft.
expect.previous: The grade the student had before the newest return, as a copy, or null.
expect.updated: True when the student page marks the grade Updated.
expect.for: Optional. Which student the check is about: s1 (the default) or s2.
expect.returned_at: Optional. Whether the date the grade was last returned is unchanged or changed since the check before it in the same case.

how_to_read.copy: A grade as JSON: v (always 1), value, modifier and comment from the score row (the Overall level, points or mark, its + or -, and the Overall Comment), tags (competency id to value, modifier, comment), criteria (criterion id to value, modifier, comment, beyond) and checks (ticked checkbox ids, sorted). A blank comment is null. A grade with nothing in it is null, not an empty copy.

cases.name: A new grade is a draft until it is returned
A change to a returned grade waits, and the student keeps the grade that was returned
A returned grade changed and put back is not a draft
The same save sent twice is not a draft (Undo sends every write twice)
A draft cleared before it was returned leaves nothing
A returned grade that is cleared waits as a draft, then returns as no grade
A cleared level is a 0 write: one competency cleared on a returned grade waits like any change
Missing on unscored rubric work is never a draft (the client sends the status, then a 0 for every criterion)
Missing on unscored competency work is never a draft (the status, then a 0 for every competency)
Late on a returned grade shows at once and is not a draft
A status on a draft shows at once; the grade still waits
A Note for the Report never makes a draft
An Overall Comment on a returned grade is a change
A rubric grade: levels, notes and ticks wait together, and a tick taken off and put back is not a draft
As Soon As I Save: a save is returned at once, and a change nobody saw is not marked Updated
As Soon As I Save: a change to a grade the student has seen is marked Updated, until it is put back
As Soon As I Save: a cleared grade is gone at once
A class with no choice made works as As Soon As I Save
With the student page off, every save is returned at once whatever Return Grades says
Turning on When I Return Them: grades already returned stay returned, and the next change waits
Switching to As Soon As I Save returns a waiting draft with the change
Switching to As Soon As I Save returns a waiting change to a returned grade, marked Updated
Turning the student page off returns what was waiting, and turning it on again leaves it returned
Clear Score keeps the Overall Comment, the ticks and the status
A level cleared while its comment stays
Points of 0 are a grade
An Overall Comment alone is a draft
A tick alone is a draft
A criterion note alone, with no level, is a draft
A comment of only spaces is blank: no draft
A + or - alone is a change
Updated stays after the student opens the piece
As Soon As I Save: a second change after a second look is Updated from what they last saw
Return in an As Soon As I Save class changes nothing
Edit a Copy moves a returned grade to the copy rubric and it stays Returned; a change after that waits
Deleting a criterion: the grade waits as a draft, and the student page drops the criterion at once
Deleting a competency: the grade waits as a draft, and the student page drops the competency at once
Deleting a checkbox: the grade waits as a draft, and the student page drops the tick at once
Two students returned in one action
The returned date holds while a draft waits, and moves when it is returned
Missing wins at once: a returned grade that is cleared and marked Missing shows no result, and comes back if Missing is taken off
Excused wins at once too: no result shows while a piece is Excused, and the returned grade comes back when it is taken off
Competency work that holds only an Overall level: the level is given (the app shows it under the first competency)
Competency work with a competency level and an Overall level: only the competency level is given
A DIBELS benchmark is a reading record, not a grade that is returned: a comment saved on it is never a draft, Return does nothing, and the student is given no grade for it
